actions.action: Create a receipt-linked item record at intake
actions.mechanism: A persistent item identifier connects ownership, physical location, work status, and the responsible volunteer.
actions.implementation: Give the visitor a numbered receipt; attach the matching number to the item. Record owner contact, location, status, custodian, and next action.
actions.check: Sample five stored items each shift: every identifier must resolve to its receipt record and actual location.
actions.risk: Protect owner contact details from public view.

actions.mechanism: Mandatory review points prevent uncertain diagnosis from occupying a workbench without a deliberate continuation decision.
actions.implementation: Set a 15-minute initial diagnostic review. At review, record continue, safely pause, or await parts, plus next action. Only the specialist opens electrical equipment.
actions.check: Audit bench records: every diagnostic interval exceeding 15 minutes must have a recorded review and disposition.
actions.risk: Never rush safety work to meet the review interval.

actions.mechanism: One bench favors assessed, bounded work; aging prevents repeatedly bypassed jobs from becoming invisible.
actions.implementation: At safe release points, route assessed short jobs to one bench. Review jobs bypassed twice; when none qualify, admit uncertain work until its next review.
actions.check: Under mixed demand, verify the next qualifying job receives that bench after safe release, with bypass reviews documented.
actions.risk: Duration estimates can be wrong; retain diagnostic review points.

actions.action: Separate parts waiting from active work
actions.mechanism: An explicit blocked state keeps unavailable-part jobs out of the ready queue and off benches when safely storable.
actions.implementation: Label safely storable items WAITING FOR PARTS in an existing storage area. Record location, needed part, procurement responsibility, and review date; require reassessment before reactivation.
actions.check: Inspect every parts-waiting item: none appears ready for work, and each has a location and named next-action owner.
actions.risk: If safe storage is unavailable, arrange owner collection.

actions.action: Make specialist access an explicit work gate
actions.mechanism: A visible specialist queue prevents unauthorized opening and avoids occupying benches merely while awaiting specialist availability.
actions.implementation: General volunteers perform intake and external observation only on electrical equipment. Label it SPECIALIST REQUIRED; the specialist authorizes bench admission when available.
actions.check: Observe electrical admissions: only the specialist opens equipment, and no item occupies a bench solely awaiting specialist arrival.
actions.risk: Treat uncertain equipment classification as specialist-required until reviewed.

actions.action: Require accepted responsibility at shift handoff
actions.mechanism: A receiving person's acknowledgment closes the gap between written notes and actual responsibility for unfinished work.
actions.implementation: Outgoing and incoming custodians reconcile item identifiers, locations, status, safety restrictions, and next actions. Record acceptance; if nobody accepts, pause work and escalate to the shift coordinator.
actions.check: After handoff, ask each custodian to locate assigned items and state their next actions without consulting outgoing volunteers.
actions.risk: A signature alone can conceal an incomplete transfer.

actions.action: Separate update commitments from completion estimates
actions.mechanism: Visitors receive a reliable communication checkpoint without an unsupported promise about when uncertain work will finish.
actions.implementation: At intake and status changes, offer a next-update checkpoint. If giving a completion estimate, include an explicit uncertainty range and dependencies; otherwise state that completion is unknown.
actions.check: Audit visitor messages: every completion estimate includes a range, and elapsed update checkpoints have a recorded contact attempt.
actions.risk: Do not invent ranges where there is no defensible basis.

actions.action: Limit accepted drop-offs to traceable storage
actions.mechanism: A storage-based admission gate prevents accumulation from defeating item tracking, safe bench release, and accountable handoff.
actions.implementation: Number existing safe storage positions. Accept a drop-off only with an assigned position, receipt, and custodian; otherwise ask the visitor to retain the item and offer a return visit.
actions.check: At shift close, verify every retained item has an authorized location and no overflow occupies benches or access routes.
actions.risk: Explain that a return visit does not guarantee completion.
